bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
C="$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}')"
test -f "$C" || exit 61
docker compose -f "$C" -p deploy config -q >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 63
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115-final >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
LOCAL="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')"
BEFORE="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-menu-20261115-final --format '{{.Id}}')"
ACTIVE="$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')"
if [ "$LOCAL" = "$BEFORE" ] && [ "$ACTIVE" = "$BEFORE" ]; then echo 'PRODUCTION=RESTORED_OLD'; exit 0; fi
if [ "$ACTIVE" = "$LOCAL" ]; then echo 'PRODUCTION=NEW_RUNNING'; exit 0; fi
exit 65
